notes: CadenceIMD is a fixed-supply ERC-20 with 18 decimals. Its constructor takes no arguments and mints all 1,000,000,000 tokens once to msg.sender, the factory during launch. It has no admin powers, additional minting, transfer fees or application contracts. The pool pairs with native ETH. initialPrice records provenance; the opening price is derived from initialMarketCapWei and totalSupply.
